description: Reference for the CI retrieval-benchmark gate (run_retrieval_benchmark --gate-against). Regenerate whenever the pinned commits in .github/actions/benchmark-index/action.yml, the questions, or retrieval behaviour intentionally change.
how_to_regenerate: Build the index as in .github/actions/benchmark-index/action.yml (EMBEDDING_ENABLED=False, GRAPHDB_ENABLED=False), run `python manage.py run_retrieval_benchmark --quiet --output report.json`, then copy the baseline/graph hit_at_* and mrr_at_* values from report.json['aggregate'].

environment.generated_with: postgres pgvector/pgvector:pg17, python 3.13 (CI uses pg16, python 3.11); two consecutive runs gave identical per-question results
